title: Draining the Power of a Saiyan (ORIGINAL)
description: “My, look at you. Despite being so tired, you're insatiable. Filthy boy. But that's ok, we both know it is me who makes you this way ... My presence, just makes you feel that happy. Do you know how excited I am? Having you all to myself once more. And I have a special surprise for you pet. We are about to have so much fun together.” “You know, I love role-playing. And we both know how much you love your gaming. So I figured, since you've been so sweet for me recently, let's see what mischief we can get up to, in this world that's been keeping you away from me all these nights. Let's see. Hmm ... You can be a Saiyan. And I will be an Android. Your favorite pink Android, with the tail, and a few other ... surprises.” “Nuh-uh, no more spoilers, Slave. Are you ready? Of course you are.” Introducing . . . Another clash of good versus evil. In this "Dragon Ball Z"-inspired romp, you've narrowly escaped defeat, and are a spent force hidden away in your healing chamber, until disaster strikes. Captured by your sworn enemy, you must now find all your reserves of strength to outlast her challenge and resist the urge to cum!
author: Mistress Shibby
